text:
jon (Support): Escalating NimbusDocs onboarding — blocking at SSO + webhook delivery. Trial ends in 8 days, customer flagged renew risk. Ticket TCK-4821
maria (CS): On it. Can you paste the latest logs and change history?
jon (Support): Paste logs snippet:
```
2026-03-15T14:22:03Z WARN webhook delivery failed 403
payload: POST /webhook/ingest 403 Forbidden
headers: x-forwarded-for: 52.14.23.11
```
jon (Support): Also customer says they can't map roles via SCIM, sending screenshot.
maria (CS): Thx. I'll book a warm intro with the customer tomorrow. @sam (Head CS) FYI — this is priority P1 for renewal.
sam (Head CS): Thanks — allocate 2h of enablement this week. Plan: 1) immediate workaround (shared key) 2) deep-dive session (30m) 3) confirm SCIM mapping + update runbook. Maria can you confirm availability?
maria (CS): Available Thu 10am PT. I'll send calendar + the comms template below.
maria (CS): Comms template:
- Subject: NimbusDocs onboarding pause — next steps
- Lead: maria@redwood.com
- Message: acknowledge issue, provide interim workaround (shared key), propose live session Thu 10am PT
- Action items: attach screenshot guide, include ticket link https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/TCK-4821
- Follow-ups: 48h check-in, 7d status update
lee (Infra Eng): FYI I pushed a temporary ACL rule to allow webhook delivery from their IPs. Rolling back in 24h unless issues.
ops-bot: deploy 0.3.9 -> prod succeeded :white_check_mark:
jon (Support): Customer confirmed Thu 10am. I sent access for shared key and SCIM sample CSV.
maria (CS): After session we'll run a quick health probe: success rate, latency, token usage. If still failing, propose a 30-day renewal hold and exec alert.
sam (Head CS): Approved. Maria, draft the renewal note and include cadence for follow-up (48h, 7d). Keep me in cc.
maria (CS): Will do. Closing loop here — thanks team :raised_hands:
